item.title: Zotero Model Context Protocol Connects Research Library to Claude, ChatGPT and More
item.description:
Zotero Model Context Protocol Connects Research Library to Claude, ChatGPT and More

Zotero has released the Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, allowing its research library to be accessed directly from AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT.

🔍 Overview

  • Connects Zotero library with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol.
  • Enables searching, reading, citing, and annotating papers from within the AI chat.
  • Supports semantic search using local, OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama embeddings.

🧩 How it works

  • A single package, zotero-mcp-server, provides three components: MCP server, CLI + agent skill, and Zotero Agent.
  • MCP server communicates with chat apps that speak MCP but have no shell (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cherry Studio, Chorus).
  • CLI + agent skill is for agents with a shell (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Amp, OpenCode).
  • Zotero Agent enables chatting inside Zotero next to the PDF you are reading.
Component Supported Apps
MCP server Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cherry Studio, Chorus
CLI + agent skill Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Amp, OpenCode
Zotero Agent Chat inside Zotero (next to PDF)

⚙️ Key details

  • Search by title, author, tag, collection, full text, or meaning (semantic search).
  • Read metadata, BibTeX, full text, page ranges, and page images where text extraction garbles math, figures, and tables.
  • Annotate highlights, area boxes, notes, and extract PDF annotations.
  • Write: add papers by DOI, URL, ISBN, BibTeX, or file; manage collections and tags; merge duplicates.
  • In local mode reads come straight from zotero.sqlite; writes go to the running Zotero 10+ or through the web API.
  • Optional Scite citation tallies and retraction alerts.
  • CLI + agent skill keeps 98 tokens in context until needed, instead of ~8k.
  • Zotero Agent knows the item, page and selection you have open; answers link to pages.

🚀 Availability

  • Requires Python 3.10+.
  • Install with uv tool install zotero-mcp-server or pip install zotero-mcp-server.
  • Setup commands: zotero-mcp setup (auto‑configures Claude Desktop), zotero-mcp install-skill for the CLI + agent skill, and install the .xpi in Zotero after adding the zotero-cli plugin for Zotero Agent.
  • To enable Zotero’s local API in Zotero 7+, open Settings → Advanced and tick Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero.
  • One package ships all three components.

💡 Why it matters

  • Provides direct access to a personal research library from AI chat interfaces.
  • Enables semantic search and citation management without leaving the conversation.
  • Handles PDF annotations, math, figures, and tables more accurately.
  • Reduces context size for agents, keeping only 98 tokens until needed.

#Zotero #AIIntegration #ModelContextProtocol

Source: 54yyyu/zotero-mcp

item.title: Self-learning AI agent with IDE, messaging, and memory
item.description:
Self-learning AI agent with IDE, messaging, and memory

A new 24/7 self-learning AI agent has been introduced, featuring an integrated IDE workspace that runs itself. The system operates without requiring extra API keys, working directly with existing Claude Code or OpenAI Codex subscriptions.

🧩 How it works

The agent manages its own goals, tracks research, and executes a full pipeline involving research, planning, review, and execution. It proposes goals and writes plans, which users can approve from a desktop app or via messaging platforms. The system maintains a persistent memory, remembering decisions, preferences, and context across every session, and supports full-text search over all past conversations.

⚙️ Key details

The agent includes several integrated components for development and automation:

  • IDE Workspace: Features a file explorer with keyboard navigation, a Monaco editor with autosave, a Git panel with ahead/behind status, and a real PTY terminal with tabs, split panes, and diff view.
  • Scheduling & Automation: Supports cron jobs, scheduled pulses, recurring tasks, and iCal RRULE support. It can sync with Apple Calendar, displaying tasks on Apple Watch and iPhone.
  • Communication: Messages users on Telegram and WhatsApp, supporting text, photos, voice, and documents. The same agent context and memory are shared between desktop and messaging sessions.
  • Skills & Extensions: Includes built-in skills for GitHub, email, macOS, PR review, and agent swarms. Users can browse community skills and connect MCP servers via Smithery.
  • Browser Automation: Performs 40+ actions using the user’s real Chrome profile.
  • Multimodal Input: Accepts images, screenshots, and diagrams that the agent can process.

📊 Model Support

The agent is multi-provider, supporting the following models:

Provider Capability
Claude Use existing subscription
OpenAI Codex Use existing subscription
MiniMax Supported provider

🔒 Security & Updates

The application is local-only with no cloud relay. It features auto-update capabilities with signed, notarized, one-click updates.

💡 Why it matters

By integrating a full IDE workspace, persistent memory, and direct messaging capabilities, this agent allows users to delegate complex workflows and research tasks. It leverages existing subscription models to provide a comprehensive development and automation environment that operates autonomously while remaining user-controlled.

#AIagents #Developertools #Automation #Claude #OpenAICodex

Source: suitedaces/dorabot

item.title: Pi AI-agent Runtime Expands with Pluggable Extension Packages
item.description:
Pi AI-agent Runtime Expands with Pluggable Extension Packages

Pi AI-agent runtime now supports pluggable extension packages that expose LLM-callable tools via MCP, covering workspace integrations, automation, memory, scheduling, and more. These packages enable developers to build composable AI agents using shared TypeScript libraries.

🧩 Available Extensions

The following extension packages are available under the @amaster.ai npm scope:

Package Purpose
@amaster.ai/pi-browser-use Browser automation via chrome-devtools-mcp
@amaster.ai/pi-attachments Attachment normalization, upload handling, document parsing
@amaster.ai/pi-telemetry Runtime traces, TTFT, token/cost accounting
@amaster.ai/pi-task-scheduler Cron-based scheduled task management
@amaster.ai/pi-goal Goal derivation and agent condition monitoring
@amaster.ai/pi-web-access Web search, URL extraction, image search
@amaster.ai/pi-computer-use Cross-platform desktop automation
@amaster.ai/pi-channels Feishu, WeCom, and webhook messaging
@amaster.ai/pi-memory Persistent curated memory injection
@amaster.ai/pi-security Resource-aware security policy engine
@amaster.ai/pi-teamwork Team collaboration and issue management
@amaster.ai/pi-image-gen Image generation via multiple providers
@amaster.ai/pi-video-gen Video model clips and batch rendering
@amaster.ai/pi-lark Lark/Feishu workspace integration
@amaster.ai/pi-wecom WeCom workspace integration
@amaster.ai/pi-dingtalk DingTalk workspace integration

⚙️ Core Packages

Package Purpose
@amaster.ai/pi-shared Shared runtime types and contracts
@amaster.ai/pi-storage JSON-file and MySQL/Prisma persistence adapters

🚀 Key Capabilities

  • Each extension exposes LLM-callable tools via MCP
  • Host applications provide HTTP routing, authentication, and product-specific UI
  • Packages are ESM-only and composable
  • On Pi 0.99+, video, teamwork, and memory tools expose bounded structured results
  • Scripts can consume IDs, memory entries, media paths, and QC metadata
  • Extension packages declare their entry point in the pi.extensions field of package.json

#AIagents #TypeScript #MCP #LLM #Automation #Plugins

Source: TGYD-helige/pi

item.title: LearnPrompt and associated agent skills gain 800+ GitHub stars
item.description:
LearnPrompt and associated agent skills gain 800+ GitHub stars

LearnPrompt, described as the account’s earliest public project, has been updated with a suite of agent skills and automated tools. The project recently reached a milestone of 800+ stars within one month of launch. The update includes the AI News Radar’s ‘伯乐’ skill, which automated the maintenance of the radar tool, and a new collection of 14 installable Agent Skills designed for heavy agent users.

🧩 Core Features

The ecosystem now centers on several key tools:

  • AI News Radar: Utilizes GitHub Actions, web interfaces, and automated summaries to monitor AI and tech information sources. It determines the value of new sources via a 7-day cooling-off period, checks for content duplication, and identifies stable integration methods. Its first application was upgrading ai-news-radar from v0.6 to v0.7.0, merging 4 PRs in a single dialogue.
  • Information Monitoring Methodology: Establishes a public method for monitoring information sources that involves fixed scraping criteria, daily snapshots, historical comparisons, and report generation, with results posted to a GitHub Pages site.
  • 淘金小镇: Tracks daily AI skill trends starting from ClawHub Top 100, expanding to monitor update logs (e.g., Claude Code) and model leaderboards (e.g., AA Index) with minimal environment dependencies.
  • Humanize PPT: Processes over 50 TED speeches to analyze main themes, audience perception, and narrative order before generating PPT content.

🧩 Installable Agent Skills

The update includes 14 installable skills that transform agent workflows into public, verifiable assets:

Skill Name Function
鲁班 Refines usable skills into installable, distributable, and verifiable public assets.
庖丁 Dissects viral content strategies without API usage, distilling them into installable content coaching.
蔡伦 Converts dialogue conclusions into shareable one-page documents in 3 seconds.
阿福 Manages the Obsidian inbox, linking items directly to the calendar.
愚公 Automates agent loops to handle long tasks without manual prompting.
搭子 Coordinates Claude Code for planning/review and Codex for implementation/closure, using a Session Receipt for logging.
Irasutoya配图 Converts key judgments from articles into Irasutoya-style reaction character images.
CC Harness六件套 Provides memory, compression, verification, and scheduling for heavy agent users via a single command.
bugu Reports agent status via vocal cues during long tasks.
carl-weread Recommends book sections based on user blockers.
x-article-publisher Converts Feishu documents into X Articles in one click.

The collection also includes automated research loops, idea files, LLM simulation debates, meta-reflection, and behavioral guidelines for code writing.

💡 Context

LearnPrompt serves as a continuously maintained Chinese AI learning path covering topics such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, prompt engineering, ChatGPT, RAG, Agents, AI programming, Agent Skills, Obsidian, Midjourney, Runway, Stable Diffusion, digital humans, AI voice/music, and large model fine-tuning.

#LearnPrompt #AgentSkills #GitHub #AIProductivity #Automation

Source: LearnPrompt/LearnPrompt

item.title: Discord Update Adds Correct Markdown Rendering and New Server‑Organization Feature
item.description:
Discord Update Adds Correct Markdown Rendering and New Server‑Organization Feature

Discord released a new update today that fixes Markdown preview rendering and adds a few usability tweaks.

📢 Overview

The company says the update “has a big improvement for Markdown previews: they should now render correctly instead of with “a bunch of symbols,”” and that Markdown files now “render ‘all nice and neat’ thanks to a new update.”

🛠️ New Markdown Rendering

  • “Discord’s latest update released today has a big improvement for Markdown previews: they should now render correctly instead of with “a bunch of symbols,” according to the company.”
  • “Markdown files in Discord now render ‘all nice and neat’ thanks to a new update.”
  • “When you upload a Markdown (.md) file, you’ll now see the file rendered all nice and neat and pretty instead of with a bunch of symbols,” Discord says.”
  • “This includes tables, formatting, all that good stuff.”
  • “Totally great for when you’re doing a casual Sunday-night sharing READMEs with your friends.”
Feature Detail
Markdown preview rendering “now render correctly instead of with a bunch of symbols”
Server/channel organization “new ‘Move to…’ feature accessible by right‑clicking the icon on the sidebar”
Nitro file size limit “upload files as large as 1 GB”

📂 Organization Tools

Discord says its new update also lets you organize servers and channels “by right‑clicking the icon on the sidebar and using a new “Move to…” feature.”

📁 Larger Upload Limits

Discord Nitro members are also now able to “upload files as large as 1GB.”

🤖 Why it matters for AI

“LLMs and AI agents often rely on Markdown files for instructions and context, so these improved previews could be helpful for people sharing information about AI projects on the platform.”

📄 Related Markdown Improvements

Google has also improved its Markdown support, as it recently started “letting users edit Markdown files directly in Docs without having to convert the files to the Docs format.”

#Discord #Markdown #AI #Productivity

Source: Discord now formats Markdown previews right

item.title: Local AI Agent Hermes Enables Personal Automation on High‑Memory Macs
item.description:
Local AI Agent Hermes Enables Personal Automation on High‑Memory Macs

I’m embarking on a journey I’ve so far been hesitant to go on: actually using AI on the regular, this time by running a self‑hosted agent locally on a powerful Mac.

🔍 Overview

  • Concerns about giving personal data to cloud services motivated a shift to local AI.
  • Apple’s new Mac desktops are marketed for local AI workloads, and upcoming RTX Spark Windows machines promise up to 128 GB RAM for agentic AI.
  • The author’s M5 Ultra Mac Studio has 256 GB unified memory, sufficient for almost any model.

🛠️ How it works

  • Hermes is a self‑hosted AI agent desktop app that runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
  • It is completely free when using local LLMs.
  • The onboarding interface includes a model picker; the author selected Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, a 125‑billion‑parameter model (~105 GB).
  • Hermes can be controlled via a Telegram bot, enabling daily briefings and other tasks.

📦 Devices & Models

Device Memory / Specs Planned Use
M5 Ultra Mac Studio 256 GB unified memory Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next and other large models
M6 Mac Mini – Try smaller Qwen models
M5 MacBook Air – Try smaller Qwen models
Asus TUF Gaming A14 (AMD Strix Halo) – Try smaller Qwen models
RTX Spark (future) up to 128 GB RAM Agentic AI experiments

✅ Practical Use Cases

  • Daily morning briefing: Hermes scans email and calendar, reports urgent items and weather; set up as a cron job at 7:30 am (macOS must be awake).
  • Steam library organization: After registering a Steam Web API key, Hermes categorized over 400 games in minutes; the key was revoked afterward.
  • Financial record crunching: Hermes processed sensitive financial data locally.
  • Spec‑comparison spreadsheet: Generated a laptop comparison sheet for a new, embargoed device, keeping the information on‑device.
  • Benchmark automation: Working on a script to run repeated laptop benchmark tests, reducing manual effort.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Local AI requires explicit permissions (e.g., Steam API key) that can be revoked after use.
  • Running models locally eliminates token costs; the author chose a large model to start.
  • Larger models (billions of parameters) generally outperform smaller ones.
  • The daily briefing initially failed until the author ensured the Mac was not asleep when the cron job fired.

💡 Why it matters

  • Sensitive data stays on the user’s machine, addressing privacy concerns with cloud services.
  • Free, local execution of powerful LLMs makes advanced AI capabilities accessible without recurring token fees.
  • A single self‑hosted app can automate a range of personal productivity tasks, from email summaries to game library management.

#LocalAI #Hermes #SelfHosted #LLM #Automation

Source: Learning to use local AI is exciting, overwhelming, and frustrating

item.title: Workshop Teaches Building a Competitive Intelligence AI Agent in 3 Hours
item.description:
Workshop Teaches Building a Competitive Intelligence AI Agent in 3 Hours

A new online workshop, “3 Hours to Research Intelligence: Build Your First AI Agent,” lets participants create a custom AI research agent that can save 10+ hours a week on job‑search or competitive‑analysis tasks.

🔍 Overview

  • Current research is fragmented: scattered reviews, Google searches, LinkedIn checks, and missed details.
  • The workshop promises to replace that manual workflow with an automated agent built in just 3 hours.

🛠️ What You’ll Build

  • Fork a ready‑made competitive‑intelligence agent from GitHub.
  • Wire in your own data sources – RSS feeds, open APIs, or any available feed.
  • Feed the agent a company or industry keyword.
  • Receive structured intelligence including recent news, hiring patterns, market positioning, gaps, and red‑flags.
  • Walk away with a deployed agent you can run 100 + times.

⏱️ Workshop Format

  • Duration: 3 hours, online.
  • Pre‑work (optional, 10 min): Clone the repo, set up your API key, verify it runs.
  • Live steps:
    1. Clone the GitHub repository.
    2. Add custom data sources.
    3. Test on a real company or competitor.
    4. Export a post‑work recap doc covering what you built, iteration tips, advanced techniques, and troubleshooting.
  • If you skip the pre‑work, the instructor will set everything up in the first 20 minutes.

🎯 Who It’s For

  • Job seekers who want to research a target employer before applying, interviewing, or accepting an offer.
  • Competitors analysts needing market gaps, hiring trends, and strategic moves.
  • Employees and side‑hustlers looking for a repeatable research workflow.

⚙️ Technical Requirements

  • A laptop with a web browser capable of accessing Claude.ai.
  • Basic comfort with Claude (already asking questions and iterating).
  • Access to RSS feeds or APIs you wish to incorporate.

📊 Modes of Use

Mode Purpose
Job Seeker Mode Research a company before you apply, interview, or accept an offer; understand growth, hiring, leadership, red‑flags.
Competitive Mode Understand what competitors are doing, market gaps, hiring trends, strategic moves.

💰 Pricing

  • One‑time fee of $17–27, covering all materials and the post‑work recap document.
  • Optional upsell: an Advanced Agent Techniques course (separate paid offering).

✅ Outcomes

  • Participants finish the session ready to run their own intelligence agent immediately.
  • The agent can be reused across dozens of companies or industries, delivering consistent, structured insights.

#AIagents #CompetitiveIntelligence #Productivity #CareerDevelopment

Source: 3 Hours to Research Intelligence: Build Your First AI Agent
